query: 首席独立董事 首席独立董事 衡量企业是否设立首席独立董事（或资深独立董事）职位的制度化程度及其实际发挥的监督作用。重点考察其授权范围、召集权、对董事长的制衡能力及履职透明度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：设有首席独立董事；具备明确的职权清单（如：在董事长缺席或回避时主持会议、批准董事会会议日程）；拥有独立召集权（可定期在无内部董事参与的情况下召集独董会议）；并详细披露了年度履职报告或具体贡献。 • 1分（合格/中低分）：名义上设立了首席独立董事或类似职位，但在公司章程或治理报告中缺乏具体的职权边界说明，且未见其独立行使召集权或监督权的实质记录。 • 0分（不合格）：未设立首席独立董事，或在董事长与 CEO 合一的情况下未建立任何抵消性的独立治理机制。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：首席独立董事的职权已正式写入《公司章程》或《董事会议事规则》，且覆盖集团所有核心治理决策环节。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：仅在个别委员会（如审计委）中发挥牵头作用，或仅作为临时性安排，未形成制度化的长效机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关制度覆盖。 首席独立董事 资深独立董事 首席独立非执行董事 独董召集人 召集独董会议 纯独董会议 批准董事会议程 制衡董事长 股东沟通联系人 履职报告 SID LID Lead Independent Director Senior Independent Director Lead Independent Non-Executive Director LID SID convene independent directors independent directors-only meeting executive session board agenda approval checks on the chair shareholder liaison 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '首席独立董事'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有普通独立董事名单；仅有董事会独立性比例；董事长与CEO分离但无首席独董；仅有ESG委员会主席；区分：首席独立董事关注独董领导与对董事长制衡；ESG监督委员会关注可持续发展议题监督，二者职位与职能不同。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

[Content]
Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

results.text: An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.
